You sit down at the kitchen table with your Player and step-sister on a Sunday morning, ready to enjoy a delicious breakfast together.



As you dig into your pancakes, you ask your mom:


Matt
So, Player, what are you up to next week?



Angela
Well, I'll have to spend most of the week working on that new project at the intergalactic research center. It's been a lot of long days, but I'm finally starting to see some progress. How about you, Matt?



Matt
I expect a pretty busy week too. I have exams soon and we are working on a group project for one of our classes.



Riley
What a nerd! Hahaha, I will probably go and visit uncle Dan and aunt Cory to Celestia



Yeah, she wants to go to Celestia to visit the family, surely not to party in the planet with the most nightlife on the galaxy


Suddenly you hear the doorbell ring.





RING RING RINGGG!
